name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1871: The in-game find date now shows on every found item rather than only the last one ticked, riding in the chip title so the wall keeps its density. And the whole chain is locked with a guard built from his own reader output: two frames by two lanes through the proposal, the gate corroborating cross-frame and cross-lane, and the exact row the board receives carrying the date and the dropper. A page that printed no date ships no key at all rather than an empty one, so the board can still tell found-on-this-date from found-date-unknown.
